about_short_description.short_description: Ember is a fintech company that provides an all-in-one accounting and tax platform to manage business finances.

product.name: Ember Accounting Platform
product.description: A software platform that automates bookkeeping, tax compliance, and financial management for SMEs in the UK.

product.name: Personal Accountant Service
product.description: A service providing SMEs with dedicated or shared expert accountants to ensure tax compliance and financial optimization.

product.name: Automated Bookkeeping
product.description: AI-driven automation of bookkeeping tasks including transaction categorization and expense management tailored to each business.

product.name: Tax Filing and Compliance
product.description: A service that manages VAT returns, company tax returns, self-assessment, and direct HMRC submissions for SMEs.

product.name: Company Formation Service
product.description: A service to register and incorporate limited companies in the UK, including name availability checks and document submission.

product.name: Expense Management Automation
product.description: Automated categorization and management of business expenses to streamline accounting processes.
